[plan-plus] The Plus plan (effective 2026-06-01)
Plus costs $5.00 a month. It's built for people who use their card a lot away from BrookLink ATMs or spend some time abroad, and it adds Cushion and a higher savings rate.

## What's included

- **Monthly fee:** $5.00
- **ATMs:** free at BrookLink ATMs, plus 3 free out-of-network withdrawals a month. After that it's $2.50 per withdrawal.
- **Foreign transaction fee:** 1% of the purchase amount
- **Card replacement:** free
- **Expedited card shipping:**

[card-replacement-plus] Card replacement fees on Plus (effective 2025-01-01)
This is what a replacement card costs on the Plus plan, whether it's lost, stolen or damaged.

| | Cost |
|---|---|
| Replacement card | free |
| Standard shipping (7 to 10 business days) | free |
| Expedited shipping (2 to 3 business days) | $25.00 |

On Plus the card itself is free. You only pay if you choose expedited shipping.

## When we don't charge

There's no fee when a card is lost in the mail, when we replace a card because of a problem on our side,

[fee-changes-2026] What changed in the March 2026 fee update (effective 2026-03-01)
2 to 3 a month.

## What stayed the same

Basic is still free. Premium is still $15.00 a month with no ATM or foreign transaction fees. Card replacement, wire and cash deposit fees didn't change on any plan.

## Why we made these changes

Out-of-network ATM operators raised what they charge us, and we moved part of that cost into the fee. We lowered the Plus foreign transaction fee at the same time, so Plus members who travel pay less overall.

If the new Plus price doesn't work for you, you can

[wires-plus] Wire fees on Plus (effective 2025-01-01)
Here's what wires cost on the Plus plan.

| Wire | Fee |
|---|---|
| Outgoing domestic | $15.00 |
| Outgoing international | $35.00 |
| Incoming domestic | free |
| Incoming international | $10.00 |

You can send up to $10,000 a day in domestic wires on Plus.

## Cutoff times

Domestic wires sent before 3:00 PM ET on a business day go out the same day.
International wires sent before 1:00 PM ET go out the same day and arrive in 1 to

[atm-fees-plus-v2] ATM fees on Plus (effective 2026-03-01)
Here's what ATM withdrawals cost on the Plus plan.

| ATM | Tallowbrook fee |
|---|---|
| BrookLink, in the US | $0.00 |
| Any other ATM in the US | first 3 each month free, then $2.50 |
| ATMs outside the US | $3.00 |

The 3 free withdrawals reset on the first day of each calendar month. Unused ones don't carry over.

| ATM | Tallowbrook fee |
|---|---|
| BrookLink, in the US | $0.00 |
| Any other ATM in the US | first 2 each month free, then $2.00 |

The 2 free withdrawals reset on the first day of each calendar month. Unused ones don't carry over.

[direct-deposit-setup] Setting up direct deposit (effective 2025-01-01)
make the switch. Your first paycheck may still go to your old account.

## Why it helps

- You may get paid up to 2 days early.
- Plus and Premium members need at least $500 in direct deposits in the last 30 days to use Cushion.

## Splitting a paycheck

Your employer may let you split your pay between accounts. You can also set up an automatic transfer from your main balance to a Savings Pocket on payday.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[cushion-plus] Cushion on Plus (effective 2025-01-01)
On Plus, Cushion covers debit card purchases up to $50.00 below zero, with no fee.

## Turning it on

Go to Profile, then Cushion. You need at least $500 in direct deposits in the last 30 days. If you stop meeting that, Cushion pauses until you do again.

## Example

If your balance is low and you buy groceries that cost more than you have, Cushion covers the difference as long as the total below zero stays within $50.00. A purchase that would take you past $50.00 below zero is declined.
